description: Curb And Sidewalk LL-WGS84 is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. Lines represent edge of curb, sidewalk and pavement. Coverage: Edmonton. Its tags are pavement, spatial, sidewalk, curb. The table has 4 columns. The portal shows 2021-06-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
